content:
Some questions regarding docs#conjugatesOf

a) Do we want to have this declaration? To me it seems largely redundant, since we already have docs#IsConj.
b) Assuming we want it, do we want to call it that? I don't see why it couldn't simply be conjugates.
c) Also assuming we want it, how should its additive version be called? Just addConjugatesOf? (I'm not particularly interested in additive conjugates, but I need to additivize them in order to additivize more important results higher up in the hierarchy)
